name: Kristina Irwin
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 2

items.text: Kristina Irwin is a real estate agent. She is a former community college student. She serves on the general advisory board at Santa Monica College and says she served as a trustee at Palisades Charter High School. She wants to establish pre-entry programs in every local high school to prepare students for community college. She also says educators need resources to design classes that fit students' needs.
